description:
Manage thread files under threads/{Projects,Processes,Topics}/.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files; open only by default.
  show THREAD [--json] — show a single thread file.
  new [--name NAME] [--kind project|process|topic] [--category professional|personal|voluntary] [--currency ISO] [--rate RATE] — create a thread file.
  delete THREAD [-y] — permanently delete a thread file.

Flags:
  list: QUERY is an optional fuzzy search, ranking results by similarity; --all includes paused and closed threads; --json JSON output.
  show: THREAD is a thread name or 'Kind/Name'; --json JSON output.
  new: --name thread name; --kind one of project, process, topic; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary; --currency 3-letter ISO code, the default currency for `hours`, optional; --rate default hourly rate for `hours`, requires --currency.
  delete: THREAD is a thread name or 'Kind/Name'; -y skips confirmation.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["list", "sgb", "--all"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "2500"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts interactively on stdin for any of --name, --kind or --category not supplied. Always pass all three so it never prompts.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is passed, and permanently removes the file. Always pass -y or do not call it.
  A thread must exist before notes, buffer entries, hours or payments can reference it.
